findings.title: Lithuanian totpStep1 replaced with an Italian sentence.
findings.body: The new value "Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:" is Italian, so Lithuanian users see Italian text on the TOTP setup page. It looks like it was copied from `messages_it`. Use a Lithuanian translation, for example "Įdiekite vieną iš šių programėlių savo mobiliajame telefone:", or remove the key so the English fallback is used.

findings.title: Lithuanian loginTotpStep1 replaced with an Italian sentence.
findings.body: `loginTotpStep1` in the Lithuanian login bundle is now Italian ("Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:"). Lithuanian users will see Italian during OTP setup at login. Replace it with Lithuanian text or remove the key so the English fallback is used.

findings.title: Account UI message switched from i18next `{{0}}` placeholders to MessageFormat syntax.
findings.body: This has the same problem as the admin UI bundle. The account UI translates with i18next, which only interpolates `{{0}}` and cannot evaluate `{2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values}`. If this key is rendered client-side, users who submit too many or too few values get a message with the raw `{0}` placeholders and choice pattern. Keep `{{n}}` interpolation in the js bundles, or confirm the server formats this message first.

findings.title: Admin UI message switched from i18next `{{0}}` placeholders to Java MessageFormat syntax.
findings.body: The admin UI bundle uses i18next interpolation (`{{error}}`, `{{fieldName}}`), and the old value deliberately used `{{0}}`, `{{1}}` and `{{2}}`. i18next does not replace `{0}` and does not understand `{2,choice,...}`. If this key is translated client-side, the multivalued-size validation error will show the raw placeholders and the choice pattern instead of the attribute name and limits. I could not see how the UI renders this key. Keep the `{{n}}` form in the js bundles, or confirm the server pre-formats this message before the UI shows it.

findings.title: Traditional Chinese text added to the Simplified Chinese (zh_CN) bundle.
findings.body: "在您的手機上安裝以下應用程式之一：" is written in Traditional Chinese with Taiwan wording (手機, 應用程式). zh_CN users will see it among Simplified text. Use the Simplified form, for example "在您的手机上安装以下应用程序之一：".
